item.title: U Mobile Launches EIP Hub to Accelerate Enterprise 5G-A, AI Adoption
item.summary: U Mobile has launched its Enterprise Innovation Platform (EIP) Hub, a facility designed to help Malaysian businesses develop, test, and demonstrate applications using 5G-Advanced (5G-A) and artificial intelligence (AI). Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil officiated the launch. The EIP Hub provides businesses with a controlled enterprise-focused testing environment to develop and validate 5G-A and AI solutions […] The post U Mobile Launches EIP Hub to Accelerate Enterprise 5G-A, AI Adoption appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
